observations: White medical device with a paper output slot in the center-left.
A sheet bearing a grayscale ultrasound image is emerging from the printer slot.
Control panel above the slot has a small screen, buttons, and knobs.
Upper compartment shows a USB port and a label with a barcode.
To the right are two drawers with white rotary handles and label windows.
Watermark text reads "SCANTRIK MEDICAL POSTED ON JIJI" across the image.
